Captured 2026-11-22 in a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org; deleted and deletion verified.
A synthetic custom profile used the Customer Community user license and API Enabled. The user was created and authenticated with the Salesforce CLI after an Experience Cloud site creation request. The site was not published.
A separate assigned permission set granted Case Read, Create and Edit but not Delete. Explicit Case Subject and Origin read/edit field grants succeeded; the attempted Status field grant was rejected as a restricted value. The native profile reported the object permissions in the outcome.
Each API ran create/update in one anonymous transaction and then attempted the delete script in a second transaction. The create/update transaction committed. Salesforce rejected the delete script during compilation, before it could execute or catch an exception. The __API__ placeholder was 62 or 67 respectively.
A second fresh 30-day scratch org repeated the same custom profile and grants for the literal-one, variable-index and system-mode controls. Each source ran independently at APIs 62.0 and 67.0 with no Case records and was rejected at compilation. The org was deleted and deletion verified.
